today_summary: GCM26 marks $4,216.2 on the 10-12 snapshot, +$59.3 (+1.43%) on the session and a new 5-day high that clears the prior $4,187.0 ceiling. The chain stays structurally call-heavy at 0.39 P/C OI, with the near-field call wall at $4,500 (10,148 OI, net GEX +102) and the first real put shelf at $4,000 (4,325 OI). Net GEX within +/-$200 of spot is -113.5 (call +254.3 against put -367.8) - still a short-gamma pocket, but half as deep as five sessions ago. ATM IV 20.29% is the 5-day low, putting the 1-sigma daily move at $53.89 (1.28%).
five_day_thesis: Spot has gone $4,156.7 to $4,216.2 (+$59.5, +1.43%) and, more importantly, finally left the $4,140-$4,187 box that contained the previous four sessions. The decisive change is gamma, not price: local net GEX inside +/-$200 repaired from -233.7 to -113.5, halving the pocket, while total chain GEX expanded +247.7 to +432.0 - a 5-day high and a 74% rebuild of the dealer cushion that eroded all of last week. The gamma flip strike has walked down from $4,855 to $4,750 (-$105), so the short-gamma zone is contracting toward spot from above rather than price climbing toward a fixed flip. Flow turned barbell rather than directional - 1,395 puts traded at $4,000 against 1,087 calls at $5,000 - lifting P/C volume 0.349 to 0.551 while P/C OI sat dead flat at 0.39 and both OI books grew by exactly +2.9%. ATM IV compressed 21.14% to 20.29% (-0.85pp) into a new spot high, the signature of a grind rather than a squeeze.

prediction: Bias cautiously bullish while $4,187 holds as the breakout shelf. With 1-sigma at $53.89 the base case is a grind to $4,270 then the $4,350 strike where net GEX first turns positive (+6.2) and upside begins to damp, with the $4,500 call wall (10,148 OI, +102 GEX) capping the swing. Loss of $4,187 returns price to the $4,140-$4,187 balance and re-deepens the pocket, with $4,100 (2,064 put OI) and $4,000 (4,325 OI) the demand shelves; max pain $5,475 sits 30% overhead on legacy call OI and exerts no pinning force at 44 DTE.
